name: Almanac
description: A thoughtful identity for an independent culture journal. An open-book emblem, deeply inked green, and index-like labels bring a sense of discovery to long-form stories.
heading: playfair
rules: The open book retains a clearly visible central spine.
Use issue numbers and running headers as integral design elements.
Combine serif titles with sans-serif paragraphs and mono-style metadata.

system.concept: Layered page objects, specimen-like illustrations, chapter rhythms, and richly readable book typography. A contemporary cultural journal that looks worth keeping.
headline: Look a little closer.
There is a story here.
features: Thoughtful records of things that can too easily go unnoticed.
A considered archive of people, places, and perspectives.
Work with enough care and character to invite another reading.
system.layoutNote: Vellum editorial hero with an open-page graphic, large serif title, running headers, and archive-green dividers. Two-column story rows on desktop, one on mobile.
